notes.title: Update 2.50 adds Traversing the Past” ~Episode Ein~
notes.notes:
Continue your journey through the past in GOD EATER 3. The final chapter “Traversing the Past” ~Episode Ein~ is now available with update 2.50. Watch the trailer:

[previewyoutube=kF3TwwTabyE;full][/previewyoutube]

Patch Content:
Mission
 Additional episode “Traversing the Past” ~ Episode Ein~ has been added
 New extra mission has been added featuring new Aragami “Ashwrought Aragami Regalia Balmung”
 New mission in “Challenge to the Hounds” has been added
 New certification missions 47-50 have been added
 New time attack missions EX23-EX26 have been added
 New special mission has been added
 New “Crimson Ashland Missions” has been added where ash anomalies constantly shift and change. (Highly difficult mission with higher appearance ratio of Abandoned God Arcs with +2)

Aragami
 New Aragami “Ashwrought Aragami Regalia Balmung” has been added

System
 New tracks have been added to Juke Box.
 New costumes and accessories have been added
 The cap of God Arc parts “+” has been raised to 60 (after finishing “Traversing the Past” ~Episode Ein~)
 New skills of Abandoned God Arc have been added

Balance Adjustment
 Burst Plugin “Combo Master” has been adjusted to be activated in the combos below:
> Long Blade: Zero Stance -> □△ combo
> All God Arc parts: Aerial attack -> Dive -> Aerial attack

A message from the Producer:
Hello everyone, 

This is Yuya Tomiyama, Producer for GOD EATER 3.
This update version 2.50 is the final update planned for GOD EATER 3.

One year and two months have passed since the release of the PlayStation 4 and PC versions and eight months have passed since the release on Nintendo Switch. Thank you so much for playing God Eater 3 for long.

We have received 3,185 pieces of feedback in total from all over the world through the God Eater 3 Opinion Box and we've read all of them, including tough and supportive comments.

We have been able to keep updating GOD EATER 3 until now thanks to your feedback through the opinion box, supportive comments and fan artwork posted on social channels. 
I am really glad if you developed bigger love for GOD EATER 3 with these updates. Please keep supporting everyone in Chrysanthemum!

Thank you,
Yuya Tomiyama

notes.title: Important Information about GOD EATER 3's Update 2.30
notes.notes:
Important Information regarding GOD EATER 3's Update Version 2.30, which was released on January 16th, 2020.

After Update Version 2.30 is applied, reward items that players can get through missions Rank 1-7 by fulfilling conditions “Complete within XX min” are not displayed and cannot be obtained.

Countermeasures
Update Version 2.31 has fixed the issue so players can see and obtain the above reward items like before Version 2.20.
This new update has been released on January 22nd, 2020.

notes.title: Patch Notes of Free Update Ver. 2.30
notes.notes:
Tied together in hardship, kept together by love. A new episode has recently been added to God Eater 3: free update 2.30 introduces “Traversing the Past” ~ Episode Phym ~ as well as a new Aragami and missions. 

[previewyoutube=1LcTDO2fHYs;full][/previewyoutube]

Mission 
 Additional episode “Traversing the Past” ~ Episode Phym ~ has been added
 New extra mission has been added featuring Aragami “Ashwrought Aragami Melammu Marduk” 
 New mission in “Challenge to the Hounds” has been added
 New certification missions 41-43 have been added	
 New time attack missions EX19-EX22 have been added
 New special mission has been added

Aragami
 New Aragami “Ashwrought Aragami Melammu Marduk” has been added

System
 Aerial enemies have been added in the preview mode
 “Hold on!” feature to Phym has been added
> You can select “Hold on!” or “Come here!” beside Phym in the base. 
 The feature to change the visual effect level has been added 
> You can select “Standard” or “Low” in Option > System > Visual Effects
 New tracks have been added to Juke Box
 New costumes and accessories have been added
 The cap of God Arc parts “+” has been raised to 50 (after finishing “Traversing the Past ~Episode Phym~)
 New skills of Abandoned God Arc have been added
 Custom Bullet duplication feature has been added
> You can confirm, arrange and save the custom bullet registered on the other players’ avatar card in your storage.

Balance Adjustments
 Adjustments on how to receive GAP
 You can receive GAP through missions “Urgent: Snack Collection 1” and “Urgent: Snack Collection 2” any number of times.
 Adjustment on the consumed amount of stamina
 Buckler: 20 -> 12
 Shield: 25 -> 15
 Tower Shield: 30 -> 18

notes.title: Update 2.00 and 2.10/2.11 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34338213/da64a4c79fdbc7c8156cb09c241508a6512eff80.jpg

New updates have recently been released for GOD EATER 3. 

FREE UPDATE 2.00

Mission
 New episode “Traversing the Past ~Episode Claire~” has been added
 Extra mission has been added where new Aragami “Ashwrought Aragami: Barbarius Ira” appears
 Certification mission 31-34 have been added

Aragami
 New Aragami “Ashwrought Aragami: Barbarius Ira” has been added

Balance Adjustment
 The Burst Plugin for Tower Shield of “Schutz Tree” has been changed to “Furious Shield”
 The upper limit of + to Abandoned God Arcs has been raised to +35 (after finishing “Traversing the Past” Claire Episode)
 “Abandoned God Arc” +2 drops in the following missions:
> EX Time Attack Mission
> Extra Mission
> Certification Mission 31-34
 A player can dive into any 360° direction of to cancel an attack when no enemy is locked on.

The future update plan:

Ver 2.10 and/or later
 Speed adjustment option on the lock-on camera will be added

Ver. 2.20 or later
 The cap of God Arc parts “+” will be raised to 45
 New Game Plus feature (TBD) will be added
 Juke Box feature (TBD) that can change the BGM in the den will be added



UPDATE VER. 2.10

Missions
 New episode “Traversing the Past” ~Episode Hugo~ and ~Episode Zeke~ have been added.
 New Extra Mission has been added where new Aragami “Ashwrought Aragami: Agni Vajra” appears.
 Special Mission “Challenge to the Hounds” has been added (High Difficulty mission)
 Certification Missions 35-37 have been added.
 New Time Attack Missions EX11-EX14 have been added.

Aragami
 New Aragami “Ashwrought Aragami: Agni Vajra” has been added.
 Ashwrought Aragami’s special effect has been added which breaks out when activated.

System
 New option to adjust the camera speed during lock-on has been added.
 The feature to remake player’s character (including the gender setting) has been added.
 New costumes and accessories have been added.
 The cap for God Arc parts “+” has been raised to 40 (after Traversing the Past ~Episode Hugo~ and ~Episode Zeke~ are cleared).
 New skills of “Abandoned God Arcs” have been added.
 The behavior of “Combat Orders >> Signal: Hold” has been changed (Automatic order cancellation after a certain period of time has passed has now become invalid.)
 Some minor issues such as those in the database text have been fixed.


UPDATE VER. 2.11
 Fixed minor bugs


Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: GOD EATER 3 - Patch 1.31
notes.notes:
A new update is now available for GOD EATER 3.

Version 1.31 implements the following improvements:
 

 Fixed various issues to provide a better gaming experience.
 Fixed an issue where in Multiplayer mode, when using mouse controls, the last text entered in a text input field would automatically be entered into the password input field.
